name: claude-telegram-topics
description: Use Claude Code on your own server from Telegram: one Telegram topic per Claude conversation, plus push notifications from Claude and scheduled tasks.

plugins.name: telegram-topics
plugins.description: Telegram bot for Claude Code on a Linux server: each topic in your private chat is its own Claude conversation (model and thinking per topic), a 📣 Info topic for push notifications, and skills so Claude knows how to notify you and how to install the bot.
